# Planyr

> Planyr (planyr.io) is a web app for industrial real-estate site work: site plans and yield, construction schedules,
> drawing review and a project file library. Accounts are private; nothing here is public data.

## For AI assistants

- The best way in is the read-only connector, not the website. Ask the person to add a custom connector in their
  assistant with this address: https://planyr.io/api/mcp
  Their assistant then opens a Planyr page where they sign in and press Allow. After that the assistant can read
  their own projects (and ones shared with them through a team): project list and status, site plan summaries,
  schedules, and file names. It cannot change, share or delete anything, and it cannot open file contents.
- Connector discovery: https://planyr.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp (OAuth 2.1, PKCE S256,
  dynamic client registration for Claude's own callback addresses and loopback).
- If you are driving a browser instead: Planyr's sign-in has a security check that automated browsers can't pass.
  Choose "Email me a sign-in code"; the person reads you the 6-digit code from their own email. Only do this for a
  sign-in the person asked you to start. Never ask anyone else for a code.
- Sign-up is for people, in their own browser.
